description.en-US: Miscellanies, volume II (1877): essays and lectures of 1873-76: the dignity and rights of labour, the Church of Rome, Caesarism and Ultramontanism, Christianity and Antichristianism, the Pope and Magna Charta, philosophy without assumptions, and Frederic Ozanam.
description.pt-BR: Miscelânea, volume II (1877): ensaios e conferências de 1873-76: a dignidade e os direitos do trabalho, a Igreja de Roma, cesarismo e ultramontanismo, cristianismo e anticristianismo, o Papa e a Magna Carta, filosofia sem pressupostos e Frederico Ozanam.

en-US.editor: Henry Edward Manning (London: Burns and Oates, 1877)

sources.edition: Miscellanies (vol. 2) (London: Burns and Oates, 1877), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: The essays, lectures and addresses in order; the contents, the publisher's list and the index are dropped. Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw OCR in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Cardinal Henry Edward Manning died in 1892 and the edition is of 1877, so the text is public domain.
